metadata.title: Diamond Maximal Operators: Classification, Moduli, and Oscillation Envelopes
metadata.abstract: We study maximal averages generated by bounded cancellative kernels taking values in finite-dimensional real normed spaces, on Euclidean balls and on balls in a non-Archimedean local field with a fixed uniformizer. For angular kernels, pointwise domination of the full maximal operators is equivalent to factorization of their angular averaging maps, with the same optimal constant. Nonzero scalar angular comparison classes are therefore projective kernel classes. For angular kernels constant on a fixed finite measurable partition of the direction space, symmetric convex bodies classify exact norm measurements, Grassmannians parametrize nonzero classes under mutual domination, and positive semidefinite Gram matrices classify Hilbert-valued measurements. For general kernels, the closed convex hull of the averaging densities obtained from all scales and the dual unit ball is a complete invariant of the full maximal operator. A dilation example exhibits identifications of residue kernels beyond scaling and unit-coordinate changes. For nonzero radial residue kernels on bounded inputs, mutual domination is classified by the unit-circle zeros of filter polynomials, counted with multiplicity, with optimal constants given by the $\ell^1$ norms of convolution quotients. We identify the envelope over all normalized bounded cancellative kernels with the best local $L^1$ approximation by constants and prove quantitative convergence of residue envelopes as the resolution increases. Finally, the weights of the finite Fourier transform classify the one-level energy and the associated Carleson functional. This functional is equivalent to the $BMO_2$ seminorm precisely when every nontrivial additive character of the residue field is detected, and the weights determine the optimal comparison constants.

analysis.workSummary: 研究欧氏及非阿基米德球上消去核生成的极大算子，以角平均映射分解、凸体及 Gram 矩阵描述支配关系，并刻画核包络及相关 Carleson 泛函。
analysis.breakthrough: 将若干极大算子比较问题写成精确的不变量与最优常数问题。
analysis.limitations: 包含多种核与输入类别，各分类结论依赖相应假设，不能合并为任意算子的统一等价。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 主要贡献在调和分析与算子分类，与几何学主线的直接联系较弱。
